greeting: Egameni likaYise, neloNyana, neloMoya oyiNgcwele. Makube noxolo lwenkosi yethu uYesu Kristu lube nani nonke.
penitential: Nkosi, usivele inceba. Kristu, usivele inceba. Nkosi, usivele inceba.
homily:
Kukho imizuzu apho ubomi bujongeka njengendiza ekhulayo, ephakamayo, ijongise impumlo yayo emazulwini, ilungele ukubona ihlabathi ngendlela entsha. Khumbula uBenjamin Vo, uBen wethu, owayethanda ukubukela iindiza, owayenomdla kwi-'con chim airlines' yakhe, le nkampani yeenqwelo-moya awayeyicinga ngengqondo yakhe eqaqambileyo. Xa uBen wayethetha ngaloo nqwelo-moya, ubuso bakhe babukhanya ngoncumo olwalungagqunywa nto, uncumo olwalubonisa ukuba intliziyo yakhe yayingeyiyo nje eyobuchwephesha okanye eyekhowudi, kodwa yayiyintliziyo eyayibona ithemba elingenasiphelo. Wayengumfana owayephethe ukukhanya okukhulu, enqwenela ukubona izinto zihamba kakuhle kwabo bonke abamngqongileyo, enqwenela ukubona indiza yakhe ibhabha ngaphaya kwamafu, njengokuba wayesoloko ecinga ngekamva elizele luvuyo.

Namhlanje, kwiNcwadi ka-Efese, uPawulos usicela ukuba sikhangele ngamehlo entliziyo. Uthi: 'Ukuba uKristu ahlale ezintliziyweni zenu ngokukholwa, ukuze nibe neengcambu nisekelwe eluthandweni.' Rooted and grounded in love. Le yimifanekiso emibini ebalulekileyo: ingcambu etshona nzulu emhlabeni, kunye nesiseko esiqinileyo esakhiwe phezu kwelitye. UBen wayengumfana owayenengqondo eqaqambileyo, kodwa ngaphezu kwako konke, wayenentliziyo eyayikwazi ukubona abanye ngendlela ebalulekileyo. Khumbula loo mzuzu apho uBen, eneminyaka elishumi nanhlanje, wathetha nabazali bakhe efuna ukunikela ngayo yonke imali yakhe yasebhange encinci ukunceda umalume wakhe uWilliam owayehlaselwe yimivumbo. Akazange ayiphule loo ngulube, akazange ayikhuphule imali, kodwa isipho sasingaphakathi entliziyweni yakhe. Ubenayo loo ntliziyo yayikwazi ukunikela ngayo yonke into ngaphandle kokubala. Loo ntliziyo yayicocekile, ingaphili ngemithetho yobuxoki yeli hlabathi, kodwa iphila ngenceba kaThixo.

KwiVangeli yanamhlanje, uYesu uthi: 'Nizele ukuzisa umlilo emhlabeni, kwaye ndinqwenela ukuba ubungatshiswa!' Lo umlilo awungomlilo otshisayo, kodwa ngumlilo wothando, umlilo wokuzinikela, umlilo oqhuba umntu ukuba abeke abanye phambi kwakhe. UYesu uthetha nge-baptism yentlungu, leyo inokumenza umntu azive ebhijelwe, kodwa uthi: 'Kukho intlungu kude kube kuhlengahlengiswe.' Le ntlungu ayiyiyo eyokuphela, kodwa yeyokuzalwa kwento entsha. UBen, ngoku, usebukhoneni obo, apho uYesu emthanda ngoxolo olungunaphakade. UBen wayengumfana owayehlala elungiselele, hayi ngokoyika, kodwa ngothando. Wayengumfana owayephila ngathi uYesu uza kufika ngalo naliphi na ixesha, kwaye wayefuna ukuba xa efika, amfumane enoncumo, enothando, kwaye enentliziyo evulekileyo.

Alan, Thao, nawe Ryan mfowethu omncane, ndiyazi ukuba kule minyane minne idlulileyo ukususela ngowe-13 kuJuni 2026, iintlungu ziza ngamanye amaxesha ngendlela embi kakhulu. Kukho amandla emphefumlo aphelileyo, kukho ubusuku obude lapho ukungabikho kwesitulo sikaBen okanye ukungaphulaphuli kwakhe amabanga ayethethwa nguyise kubangela isikhewu esingazalisekiyo. Kodwa mamela le nyaniso namhlanje: uThixo akamlibalanga uBen, kwaye akakubalelanga nani. Kwizinto ezenzekayo ebudeni bokugula, abazali abaninzi bazithwala ngokwabo umthwalo wokuzisola: 'Ngaba kukhona endinokukwenza ngcono? Ngaba ndiphosile?' Mamele kakuhle, Alan noThao: uThixo akakubeki icala. UBen akakubeki icala. Ezo zifo aziziswanga zizinto owazenzayo okanye ongazenzanga. Kweli hlabathi, kukho izinto ezenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lomntu, ngaphandle kwempazamo yomzali. Awuphosanga nto. Uthando lwakho lwalucocekile, lwaluphelele, kwaye uBen wayesazi ukuba unothando olungaka kubazali bakhe nakuRyan. Khipha elo litye lokuzisola ezintliziyweni zenu namhlanje. UBen akajongi iziphoso; ujonge phezulu kuThixo, kwaye uqhubeka esithi kuwe: 'Ba, Mama, musani ukukhala kakhulu, ndikhuselekile.'

Ryan, mfowethu omncane, ndiyazi ukuba ukhumbula uBen kakhulu. Xa ucinga ngemidlalo yenu, ngale roller coaster enayikhwela ngeziganeko ezimnandi, yazi ukuba uBen akakushiye. Ukhona ecaleni kwakho, eqhubeka ekusebenza njengesikhokelo sothando. UBen wayengumfana owayenenqgondo enkulu yezibalo ne-AI, kodwa ikratshi lakhe elikhulu kwakuwukuba ngumntwana omhle owayehlonipha abazali bakhe. UBen uya kuhlala ekukhuthaza, nangona ungamboni ngamehlo, kodwa uya kumva entliziyweni yakho. Uthando lwenu njengabazalwana luyinto engunaphakade.

Masithathe oku namhlanje: uBen wasishiya isipho sothando esingapheliyo. Kwisikhumbuzo sabangcwele abasifundisa ukuba nibe nesibindi sokuma ngenxa kaKristu, masime nathi namhlanje siqinisekile ukuba ubomi bukaBen abuphelanga ethuneni. Usemthekweni wasezulwini, apho i-'con chim airlines' yakhe ibhabha ngokuphakamileyo phambi kobuso bukaThixo. Hamba ke namhlanje uphumle, uthembe ukuba uThixo uyakuthanda, kwaye uBen ulinda wena ngoncumo lwakhe oluqhelekileyo. UBen akakho nje kwimbali yenu; ukwikhona apho uThixo enza khona yonke into ibe ntsha. Uthando lwakho, Ben, lusaqhubeka luhamba emhlabeni, lusaqhubeka lukhanya, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhumbuza wonke umntu okwaziyo ukuba uThixo uyamthanda umntwana wakhe ngaphezu kwayo yonke into. Hlalani neli themba. Hlalani nolu thando. UBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. Amen.
spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam uYesu, ndiyakholwa ukuba ukhona kwiSakramente eliNgcwele. Ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kwako konke, kwaye ndinqwenela ukukwamkela emphefumlweni wam. Njengoko ndingenakuze ndikwamkele ngoku kwiSakramente, nceda uze kum ngomoya. Ndiyakwamkela njengokungathi ukhona, kwaye ndizimanya nawe ngokupheleleyo. Ungaze undivumele ndahluke kuwe. Amen.
closing: Ngamana uThixo onamandla angakusikelela, akugcine, kwaye akukhanyisele ngoxolo lwakhe olungunaphakade. Amen.
standing_petitions: Sithandazela uBen nabo bonke abasishiyileyo, ukuze baphumle eluxolweni nasekukhanyeni kukaKristu.
Sithandazela bonke abakhathazekileyo, ukuze uThixo abathuthuzele kwaye abaphe ithemba eliqinileyo.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: Bazalwana noodade bethu: Ndiguqa phambi kukaYise, ekuthiwa ngaye yonke imizalwane ezulwini nasemhlabeni, ukuze aninike, ngokobutyebi bozuko lwakhe, ukuba nibe namandla ngomoya wakhe emntwini wenu wangaphakathi; ukuze uKristu ahlale ezintliziyweni zenu ngokukholwa, ukuze nibe neengcambu nisekelwe eluthandweni, nibe namandla okufikelela, nabo bonke abangcwele, ukuba luyintoni na ububanzi, nobude, nobunzulu, nokuphakama, nokulazi uthando lukaKristu olugqithisele elwazini, ukuze nizaliswe ngako konke ukuzala kukaThixo. Ke kuye onako ukwenza okungaphezu kwako konke esikucelayo okanye esikucingayo, ngokwamandla asebenza phakathi kwethu, kuye makube luzuko ebandleni nakuKristu Yesu, kuzo zonke izizukulwana, kude kube ngunaphakade. Amen.

readings.label: INdumiso yokuPhendula
readings.text: R. Umhlaba uzaliswe bububele beNkosi. Gcani, nina balungileyo, eNkosini; ukudunyiswa ngabathe tye kufanelekile. Yibuleleni iNkosi ngeharpe; yidumiseni ngomrhubhe onemitya elishumi. R. Umhlaba uzaliswe bububele beNkosi. Kuba ilizwi leNkosi lithe tye, kwaye yonke imisebenzi yayo ithembekile. Iyakuthanda ukulunga nobulungisa; umhlaba uzaliswe bububele beNkosi. R. Umhlaba uzaliswe bububele beNkosi. Kodwa icebo leNkosi limi ngonaphakade; iinjongo zentliziyo yayo, kuzo zonke izizukulwana. Inoyolo isizwe esinguThixo waso yiNkosi, abantu ebazikhethele ilifa layo. R. Umhlaba uzaliswe bububele beNkosi. Kodwa amehlo eNkosi aphezu kwabo bayoyikayo, kwabo bathembele kububele bayo, ukubahlangula ekufeni nokubagcina nasebudeni bendlala. R. Umhlaba uzaliswe bububele beNkosi.

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: UYesu wathi kubafundi bakhe: “Nizele ukuzisa umlilo emhlabeni, kwaye ndinqwenela ukuba ubungatshiswa! Kukho ubhaptizo ekufuneka ndibhaptizwe ngalo, kwaye indlela endibandezeleka ngayo kude kube luyagqitywa! Ngaba nicinga ukuba ndize kuzisa uxolo emhlabeni? Hayi, ndithi kuni, kodwa ndize kuzisa ukwahlukana. Ukususela ngoku indlu yabantu abahlanu iya kwahlulwa, abathathu baphikisane nababini, nababini baphikisane nabathathu; uyise uya kwahlukana nonyana wakhe, unyana no-yise, umama nentombi yakhe, intombi nonina, umamazala nomolokazana wakhe, umolokazana nomamazala wakhe.”

day: Thursday of the Twenty-ninth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!
